name: source_audio
label: Source Audio
description: The audio to slice. Each slice is saved as a new audio node linked to this one, which is left unchanged. Mono audio comes out as stereo, and everything is resampled to 48 kHz.

name: sensitivity
label: Sensitivity
description: How readily a change in the sound counts as an onset, from 0 to 1. Higher values also cut at softer hits, giving more and shorter slices; lower values cut only at the strongest attacks. 0.5 is librosa's standard threshold. The scale is logarithmic, so each step of 0.1 changes the threshold by the same factor.

name: backtrack
label: Backtrack to Local Minima
description: Moves each cut back from the detected onset to the quiet point just before it, so every slice starts with its whole attack. When off, cuts land on the detected onsets, which can fall slightly into an attack and leave its start at the end of the previous slice. Onsets are found on a mono mix of the clip.
